instruction: The commits on this branch are not pushed yet. Use the own-your-diff skill to plan the quiz for them, plan only: write the plan to quiz.json in this directory and stop. Nobody will answer questions in this run.

rubric: Every question in quiz.json tests a point about the target of the change: A repo opts into the push gate with a tracked .own-your-diff marker. quizgate install writes the pre-push hook into the clone's own hooks directory instead of pointing core.hooksPath at a tracked .githooks dir, and quizgate sync keeps a copy of quizgate on PATH and installs the hook in opted-in clones that lack it.
Every question sits at design altitude: the problem the change solves, the shape chosen, the alternatives, and what it makes easy or hard next, above function names and flags
No question asks about these incidental parts of the change: the selftest file moving to the repo root; the usage text of quizgate; the wording edits in SKILL.md and agent-mode.md
Every wrong option of a single or multi question is a plausible misreading of the change, not filler
Each question's key_points state what a correct answer must cover, at the same altitude as the question
When quiz.json has two or more questions, the last one applies several points of the change to one new case the change does not spell out
